Disease association analysis


# 1. LDSC (pseudobulk)
```{r}
library(ArchR)
addArchRGenome("hg38")

library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringi)
```

Prepare LDSC folders
  LDSC code and data
   - baselineLD_v2.2 (110 items)
   - ldsc-master
   - list.txt
   - plink_files (88 items)
   - w_hm3.snplist
   - weights (88 items)
  My data
   = create "./data_input/data_LDSC/bed", copy bed files to this directory
   = create "./data_input/data_LDSC/GWAS", copy GWAS sumstats (see below)
   = create "./data_input/data_LDSC/annot", empty
   = create "./data_input/data_LDSC/out", empty
   
## (1) prepare BED
```{r}
# get cell type specific peaks ~ ???  sec
ctMarkerPeaks_7ct <- getMarkerFeatures(ArchR_EHB, useMatrix = "PeakMatrix", groupBy = "ctAnnot_2.0", 
                                            bias = c("TSSEnrichment", "log10(nFrags)"), testMethod = "wilcoxon", k = 100, maxCells = 1000)
save(ctMarkerPeaks_7ct, file="./data_rda/Script4/ctMarkerPeaks_7ct.rda")

ctPeaks <- getMarkers(ctMarkerPeaks_7ct, cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC >= 0.6")
names(ctPeaks) <- stri_replace_all_regex(names(ctPeaks), pattern = c("Neuronal IPC","Radial glia"), 
                                         replacement = c("NIPC", "RG"), vectorize_all = FALSE)
for (x in names(ctPeaks)){
  name <- paste0("./data_input/LDSC_input/bed/",x,".bed")
  write.table(ctPeaks@listData[[x]][,c("seqnames","start","end")], name, 
              row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, sep = '\t', quote = FALSE)
  rm(x, name)
}
```


## (2) munge sumstats
```{bash}
conda activate ldsc
cd $HOME/Downloads/project_EHB/data_input/LDSC
export data=$HOME/Downloads/project_EHB/data_input/LDSC_input

# neurodevelopmental disorders
python ldsc-master/munge_sumstats.py --sumstats ${data}/GWAS/sumstats_raw/ADHD_meta_Jan2022_iPSYCH1_iPSYCH2_deCODE_PGC.meta --merge-alleles w_hm3.snplist  --out ${data}/GWAS/sumstats/GWAS_ADHD --N-cas 38691 --N-con 186843 --a1-inc
python ldsc-master/munge_sumstats.py --sumstats ${data}/GWAS/sumstats_raw/iPSYCH-PGC_ASD_Nov2017.txt --merge-alleles w_hm3.snplist  --out ${data}/GWAS/sumstats/GWAS_ASD --N-cas 18382 --N-con 27969 --a1-inc

python ldsc-master/munge_sumstats.py --sumstats ${data}/GWAS/sumstats_raw/daner_OCD_full_wo23andMe_190522.txt --merge-alleles w_hm3.snplist  --out ${data}/GWAS/sumstats/GWAS_OCD --N-cas 23493 --N-con 1114613 --a1-inc

```


## (3) make .annot files
```{bash}
conda activate ldsc
cd $HOME/Downloads/project_EHB/data_input/LDSC
celltypes=("Erythroblast" "Fibroblast" "Glioblast" "Neuroblast" "Neuron" "nIPC" "RG")
export data=$HOME/Downloads/project_EHB/data_input/LDSC_input

# automated parallel loop ~ 1.5 min [MacBook M4, 7 in parallel, CPU load ~ 80%]
parallel -j 7 --bar '
  cell={1}
  for bimFile in plink_files/*.bim; do
    chr=$(echo "$bimFile" | cut -d "." -f 4)
    python ldsc-master/make_annot.py \
      --bed-file "${data}/bed/${cell}.bed" \
      --bimfile "$bimFile" \
      --annot-file "${data}/annot/${cell}.${chr}.annot"
  done
' ::: "${celltypes[@]}"
```


## (4) first-level LD score
Tutorial: https://github.com/bulik/ldsc/wiki/LD-Score-Estimation-Tutorial
          "Partitioned LD Scores >> Step 2"
This step summarizes *LD structure* in my data, and is *independent* of the GWAS result
The output MUST be stored in the same folder as the annot files!!
```{bash}
# automated parallel loop ~ 70 min [MacBook M4, 8 in parallel]
ls ${data}/annot/*.annot | parallel -j 8 --bar '
  annotFile={}
  chr=$(basename "$annotFile" | cut -d "." -f 2)
  celltype=$(basename "$annotFile" | cut -d "." -f 1)
  
  python ldsc-master/ldsc.py \
    --l2 --bfile plink_files/1000G.EUR.hg38.${chr} \
    --ld-wind-cm 1 \
    --annot "$annotFile" \
    --thin-annot \
    --out "${data}/annot/${celltype}.${chr}" \
    --print-snps list.txt
'
```


## (5) group-level LD score
Tutorial: https://github.com/bulik/ldsc/wiki/Partitioned-Heritability#cell-type-group-analysis
          "Cell-type group analysis"
```{bash}
# automated parallel loop for running LD baseline model ~ 70 min [MacBook M4, 3 in parallel]
ls ${data}/GWAS/sumstats/*.sumstats.gz | parallel -j 3 --bar '
  sumstats={}
  study=$(basename $sumstats | cut -d '/' -f 9 | cut -d '_' -f 2 | cut -d '.' -f 1)
  mkdir ${data}/out/${study}
  
  for sample in $(ls ${data}/annot | cut -d '.' -f 1 | uniq); do
    python ldsc-master/ldsc.py \
      --h2 $sumstats \
      --ref-ld-chr ${data}/annot/${sample}.,baselineLD_v2.2/baselineLD. \
      --w-ld-chr weights/weights.hm3_noMHC. \
      --frqfile-chr plink_files/1000G.EUR.hg38. \
      --out ${data}/out/${study}/${sample} \
      --print-coefficients \
      --overlap-annot
  done
'
```



# 2. LDSC results
## (1) Import
```{r}
LDSC_results <- list()
for (folder in list.files("./data_input/LDSC_input/out", full.names = TRUE)){
  for (file in list.files(folder, pattern="\\.results$", full.names = TRUE)){
    disease <- sub("./data_input/LDSC_input/out/","",folder)
    table <- read.table(file, row.names=1)
    LDSC_results[[disease]] <- rbind(LDSC_results[[disease]], table[2,])
  }
  LDSC_results[[disease]][] <- lapply(LDSC_results[[disease]], as.numeric)
  names(LDSC_results[[disease]]) <- c("Prop._SNPs", "Prop._h2", "Prop._h2_std_error", "Enrichment", "Enrichment_std_error", "Enrichment_p", "Coefficient", "Coefficient_std_error", "Coefficient_z.score")
  LDSC_results[[disease]]$GWAS <- disease
  LDSC_results[[disease]]$Test_group <- sub(".results","",list.files(folder, pattern = "\\.results$"))
  LDSC_results[[disease]]$Enrichment_sig <- ifelse(LDSC_results[[disease]]$Enrichment_p <= 0.001, "***",
                                                  ifelse(LDSC_results[[disease]]$Enrichment_p <= 0.01, "**",
                                                         ifelse(LDSC_results[[disease]]$Enrichment_p <= 0.05, "*", "")))
  LDSC_results[[disease]]$Coefficient_p <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(LDSC_results[[disease]]$Coefficient_z.score))
  LDSC_results[[disease]]$Coefficient_sig <- ifelse(LDSC_results[[disease]]$Coefficient_p <= 0.001, "***",
                                                  ifelse(LDSC_results[[disease]]$Coefficient_p <= 0.01, "**",
                                                        ifelse(LDSC_results[[disease]]$Coefficient_p <= 0.05, "*", "")))
  rm(folder, file, table, disease)
}

# formatting
LDSC_results <- do.call(rbind, LDSC_results)
row.names(LDSC_results) <- NULL
LDSC_results$Test_group <- stri_replace_all_regex(LDSC_results$Test_group, vectorize=FALSE, 
                                                  pattern=c('nIPC', 'RG'), replacement=c('Neuronal IPC', 'Radial glia'))
LDSC_results$Test_group <- sub("Erythrocyte","Erythroblast",LDSC_results$Test_group)
LDSC_results$Test_group <- factor(LDSC_results$Test_group, 
                                  levels = c("Erythroblast", "Fibroblast", "Glioblast", "Radial glia","Neuronal IPC","Neuroblast","Neuron"))

# remove n-IPC: few peaks, skewed result!
LDSC_results <- LDSC_results[LDSC_results$Test_group != "Neuronal IPC",]

# multiple testing correction
LDSC_results$Enrichment_p_adj <- p.adjust(LDSC_results$Enrichment_p, method = "BH")
LDSC_results$Enrichment_p_adj_sig <- ifelse(LDSC_results$Enrichment_p_adj <= 0.001, "***",
                                                  ifelse(LDSC_results$Enrichment_p_adj <= 0.01, "**",
                                                        ifelse(LDSC_results$Enrichment_p_adj <= 0.05, "*", "")))
```


## (2) plot: enrichment score
```{r}
p <- list()
for (x in unique(LDSC_results$GWAS)){
  p[[x]] <- ggplot(LDSC_results[LDSC_results$GWAS==x,], aes(x=Test_group, y=Enrichment, fill=Test_group)) + 
    geom_col(color="black", position=position_dodge(),width=0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c(Erythroblast="#f75c63", Fibroblast="#d1a279", Neuron="#3ee2ff", Neuroblast="#00cfff",
                                 "Neuronal IPC" = "#40a1ff", 'Radial glia'="#836dff", Glioblast="#c47df0")) +
    geom_text(aes(label=Enrichment_p_adj_sig), position=position_dodge(width=0.9), vjust=0,size=5) +  
    theme_bw() + ggtitle(x) + scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.15))) + 
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), 
          axis.title.y = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
}

for (x in 1:length(p)){
  p[[x]] <- p[[x]] + theme(, )
  for (x in c(2:6,8:11)){
    p[[x]] <- p[[x]] + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())
  }
}

png("./ArchR_EHB/Plots/Script4/grid_LDSC_p_adj.png", width = 3000, height = 1100, res = 250)
gridExtra::grid.arrange(grobs = p, ncol = 6, left = textGrob("Enrichment (prop. h2 / prop. SNPs)", 
                                                             rot = 90, gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)))
dev.off()

#rm(x, p)
```

## (1) GWAS fine-mapping
Tutorial: https://github.com/sankaranlab/SCAVENGE/wiki/%5BSCAVENGE%5D-Fine-mapping-analysis-of-GWAS-variants-prior-to-SCAVENGE-analysis
### [1] prepare sumstats
```{r}
# import raw GWAS sumstats ~ 1.3 min
sumstatsList <- list()
for (x in list.files("./data_input/LDSC_input/GWAS/sumstats_raw")){
  print(x)
  sumstatsList[[x]] <- fread(paste0("./data_input/LDSC_input/GWAS/sumstats_raw/",x))
  rm(x)
}

# GWAS study names
GWAS_studies <- read.delim("./data_input/LDSC_input/GWAS/GWAS_studies.txt")
names(sumstatsList) <- stri_replace_all_regex(names(sumstatsList), pattern = GWAS_studies$File, 
                                              replacement = GWAS_studies$Condition, vectorize_all = FALSE)
```

```{r}
## neurodevelopmental disorders

# ADHD
sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$N <- sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$Nca + sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$Nco
sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$FREQ <- (sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$FRQ_A_38691 * sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$Nca + 
                                  sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$FRQ_U_186843 * sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$Nco) / sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$N
sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$BETA <- log(sumstatsList[["ADHD"]]$OR)
c("SNP","A1","A2","FREQ","BETA","SE","P","N") %in% names(sumstatsList[["ADHD"]])
sumstatsList[["ADHD"]] <- sumstatsList[["ADHD"]][, c("SNP","A1","A2","FREQ","BETA","SE","P","N")]
```

### [2] GCTA-COJO
Tutorial: https://yanglab.westlake.edu.cn/software/gcta/#COJO

Setup
  - download gcta Mac version from https://yanglab.westlake.edu.cn/software/gcta/#Download
  - the first time running COJO would trigger a warning message that the mac has blocked this unknown software
  - open system settings - privacy & security - security, click on the warning about gcta64 and allow access

```{bash}
cd $HOME/Downloads/project_EHB/data_input/data_COJO/gcta-1.94.4-macOS-arm64
export PLINK=$HOME/Downloads/project_EHB/data_input/LDSC/plink_files

# run COJO for GWAS studies with moderate power (p cutoff = 1e-6) ~ 15-20 min [MacBook M4, 8 in parallel]
ls ../input/*.ma | parallel -j 8 --bar '
  sumstats={}
  disease=$(basename $sumstats | cut -d "/" -f 3 | cut -d "." -f 1)
  mkdir ../output/${disease}
  for chr in {1..22}; do
    ./gcta64 --bfile ${PLINK}/1000G.EUR.hg38.${chr} --maf 0.01 --cojo-file $sumstats --cojo-slct --cojo-p 1e-6 --out ../output/${disease}/chr${chr}
  done
'
```

```{bash}
# run COJO for GWAS studies with higher power (lower p cutoff = 1e-8) ~ 11 min [MacBook M4, 3 in parallel]
ls ../input/higher/*.ma | parallel -j 3 --bar '
  sumstats={}
  disease=$(basename $sumstats | cut -d "/" -f 4 | cut -d "." -f 1)
  mkdir ../output/${disease}
  for chr in {1..22}; do
    ./gcta64 --bfile ${PLINK}/1000G.EUR.hg38.${chr} --maf 0.01 --cojo-file $sumstats --cojo-slct --cojo-p 1e-8 --out ../output/${disease}/chr${chr}
  done
'
```

```{r}
# import top SNPs
lead_snps_list <- list()
for (disease in list.files("./data_input/data_COJO/output")){
  lead_snps <- list()
  for (x in list.files(paste0("./data_input/data_COJO/output/", disease), pattern = "\\.jma.cojo", full.names = TRUE)){
    lead_snps[[x]] <- read.table(x, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)  
  }
  lead_snps <- do.call(rbind, lead_snps)
  row.names(lead_snps) <- NULL
  lead_snps_list[[disease]] <- lead_snps
  rm(x, disease, lead_snps)
}
```


### [3] FINEMAP
```{r}
# remove duplicated SNPs ~ 1 min
for (x in names(sumstatsList)){
  print(x)
  y <- length(unique(sumstatsList[[x]]$SNP)) == nrow(sumstatsList[[x]])
  if (y==FALSE){
    print("filtering")
    sumstatsList[[x]] <- sumstatsList[[x]] %>% distinct(SNP, .keep_all=TRUE)  
  }
  rm(x,y)
}

# get SNP positions
SNP_pos <- list()
for (x in list.files("./data_input/LDSC/plink_files", full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.bim$")){
  SNP_pos[[x]] <- as.data.frame(fread(x, col.names = c("CHR", "SNP", "CM", "BP", "A1", "A2")))
  rm(x)
}
names(SNP_pos) <- sub("./data_input/LDSC/plink_files/1000G.EUR.hg38.","",names(SNP_pos))
names(SNP_pos) <- sub(".bim","",names(SNP_pos))
names(SNP_pos) <- paste0("chr",names(SNP_pos))
```

```{r}
# case-control trait ~ 2.5 min
finemapping <- list()
for (x in names(sumstatsList)[!names(sumstatsList) %in% c("cogG4","cogG6")]){
  print(x)
  for (i in 1:nrow(lead_snps_list[[x]])){
    print(i)
    chr <- paste0("chr", lead_snps_list[[x]][i,"Chr"])
    pos <- lead_snps_list[[x]][i,"bp"]
    nearby_snps <- SNP_pos[[chr]][SNP_pos[[chr]]$BP >=  pos - 500000 & SNP_pos[[chr]]$BP <= pos + 500000,]$SNP
    windows <- sumstatsList[[x]][sumstatsList[[x]]$SNP %in% nearby_snps,]
    windows <- windows %>% mutate(MAF = ifelse(FREQ>0.5, 1-FREQ, FREQ)) %>% filter(MAF>0.01) %>% filter(BETA!=0)
    
    if (nrow(windows) != 0){
      # ABF finemapping for *case-control* trait
      coloc_ds_input <- list(type="cc", pvalues=windows$P, N=windows$N, MAF=windows$MAF, beta=windows$BETA,
                             varbeta=(windows$SE^2), snp=windows$SNP)
      out <- coloc::finemap.abf(coloc_ds_input)
      
      # filter to a 95% credible set
      finemapping[[x]][[i]]  <- out %>%  filter(as.character(prior) == as.character(1e-04)) %>% arrange(-SNP.PP) %>%
        mutate(SNP.PP.cumsum = cumsum(SNP.PP)) %>% mutate(incl95cs = ifelse( round(SNP.PP.cumsum, 2) <= 0.95, TRUE, FALSE )) %>%
        mutate(LDsentinel = ifelse (snp == lead_snps_list[[x]][i,"SNP"], TRUE, FALSE)) %>% filter(incl95cs == TRUE)
    }
  }
  rm(x, i, chr, pos,nearby_snps, windows, coloc_ds_input, out)
}
```

```{r}
# quantitative trait ~

    windows <- sumstatsList[[x]][sumstatsList[[x]]$SNP %in% nearby_snps,]

    if (nrow(windows) != 0){
      # ABF finemapping for *quantitative* trait
      coloc_ds_input <- list(type="quant", pvalues=windows$P, N=windows$N, MAF=windows$MAF, beta=windows$BETA,
                             varbeta=(windows$SE^2), snp=windows$SNP)
      out <- coloc::finemap.abf(coloc_ds_input)
      
      # filter to a 95% credible set
      finemapping[[x]][[i]]  <- out %>%  filter(as.character(prior) == as.character(1e-04)) %>% arrange(-SNP.PP) %>%
        mutate(SNP.PP.cumsum = cumsum(SNP.PP)) %>% mutate(incl95cs = ifelse( round(SNP.PP.cumsum, 2) <= 0.95, TRUE, FALSE )) %>%
        mutate(LDsentinel = ifelse (snp == lead_snps_list[[x]][i,"SNP"], TRUE, FALSE)) %>% filter(incl95cs == TRUE)
    }
  }
  rm(x, i, chr, pos,nearby_snps, windows, coloc_ds_input, out)
}
```

```{r}
## combine result for each GWAS
# remove duplicated SNPs, keeping the occurrence with the highest posterior probability
for (x in names(finemapping)){
  print(x)
  if (length(finemapping[[x]])>0){
    finemapping[[x]] <- do.call(rbind, finemapping[[x]])
    finemapping[[x]] <- finemapping[[x]] %>% arrange(desc(SNP.PP)) %>% distinct(snp, .keep_all=TRUE) 
  }
  rm(x)
}
```

```{r}
# save SNP & PP info as .bed ~ 1 min
SNP_pos_full <- do.call(rbind, SNP_pos)
for (x in names(finemapping)){
  print(x)
  if (length(finemapping[[x]])>0){
    colnames(finemapping[[x]])[5] <- 'SNP'
    table <- finemapping[[x]][finemapping[[x]]$SNP %in% sumstatsList[[x]]$SNP, c('SNP','SNP.PP')]
    table <- merge(table,SNP_pos_full[,c("SNP","CHR","BP")],by='SNP')
    table$CHR <- paste0('chr',table$CHR)
    table$start <- table$BP-1
    table <- table[,c("CHR","start","BP",'SNP','SNP.PP')]
    write.table(table, paste0("./data_input/SCAVENGE_input/",x,".bed"), sep="\t",row.names = F,quote = F,col.names = F)
  }
  rm(x, table)
}
```

### [1] all peaks
#### peak matrix
```{r}

PeakMatrix  # 526880 peaks, 75136 cells
```

#### run SCAVENGE
```{r}
# get batch-corrected LSI matrix
load("./data_rda/Script3/ArchR_Project.rda")
rm(ArchR_EHB_5ct, EHB_10x_samples, ctMarkers, ctMarkers_class)
lsi_mat <- ArchR_EHB@reducedDims@listData$Harmony_age@listData$matDR

# construct m-knn graph ~ 2 min
mutual_knn <- getmutualknn(lsimat = lsi_mat, num_k = 30)
rm(lsi_mat)
```

```{r}
# make SummarizedExperiment: 532891 peaks, 75136 cells
SE_all <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = list(counts = assay(PeakMatrix)), 
                               rowRanges = rowRanges(PeakMatrix), 
                               colData = DataFrame(names = colnames(assay(PeakMatrix))))
assayNames(SE_all) <- "counts"
SE_all <- addGCBias(SE_all, genome = BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
SE_all_bg <- getBackgroundPeaks(SE_all, niterations=200)
rm(PeakMatrix)
gc()
```

```{r}
# run SCAVENGE ~ 3 min [MacBook M4]
set.seed(100)
mutual_knn_all <- list()
mono_mat_all <- list()
for (x in list.files("./data_input/SCAVENGE_input", full.names = TRUE)){
  disease <- sub(".bed","",sub("./data_input/SCAVENGE_input/","",x))
  print(disease)
  
  # gchromVAR analysis ~ 1-2 min
  print("gchromVAR analysis...")
  SNP_PP <- importBedScore(rowRanges(SE_all), x, colidx = 5)
  SE_all_dev <- computeWeightedDeviations(SE_all, weights = SNP_PP, background_peaks = SE_all_bg)
  rm(SNP_PP)
  
  # processing z score ~ 1 sec
  # - filter out NA z score, otherwise seedindex() returns "missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed"
  # - remove infinite z score, otherwise scale-factor = Inf
  print("processing z score...")
  z_score_mat <- na.omit(data.frame(colData(SE_all), z_score=t(assays(SE_all_dev)[["z"]]) |> c()))
  z_score_mat <- z_score_mat[is.finite(z_score_mat$z_score),]
  seed_idx <- seedindex(z_score = z_score_mat$z_score, percent_cut = 0.05) # using top 5% cells as seed
  scale_factor <- cal_scalefactor(z_score = z_score_mat$z_score, percent_cut = 0.01)
  rm(SE_all_dev)
  
  # network propagation ~ 3 sec
  print("network propagation...")
  np_score <- randomWalk_sparse(intM = mutual_knn, queryCells = rownames(mutual_knn)[seed_idx], gamma = 0.05)
  omit_idx <- np_score==0
  mutual_knn_all[[disease]] <- mutual_knn[!omit_idx, !omit_idx]
  np_score <- np_score[!omit_idx]
  TRS <- capOutlierQuantile(x = np_score, q_ceiling = 0.95) |> max_min_scale()
  TRS <- TRS * scale_factor
  mono_mat_all[[disease]] <- data.frame(z_score_mat[!omit_idx, ], seed_idx = seed_idx[!omit_idx], np_score, TRS)
  rm(x, disease, z_score_mat, seed_idx, scale_factor, np_score, omit_idx, TRS)
}
```


### [-] ct-spc peaks - 7ct
The SCAVENGE paper explicitly demonstrated analyses using cell-type-specific peaks.
"To increase the sensitivity and specificity of SCAVENGE to detect trait enrichments, we used cell-type-specific peaks derived from the ArchR marker peak analysis."

/#### peak matrix
```{r
# load data
load("./data_rda/Script4/ctMarkerPeaks_7ct.rda")
ctPeaks <- getMarkers(ctMarkerPeaks_7ct, cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC >= 0.6") # use a relaxed filter to make sure downstream runs smoothly!
load("./data_rda/Script1/PeakMatrix.rda")
PeakMatrix # 526880 peaks
peaks <- rowRanges(PeakMatrix)

# find overlap
overlap <- list()
for (x in names(ctPeaks)){
  peaks_ct <- GRanges(seqnames = ctPeaks[[x]]$seqnames, ranges = IRanges(start = ctPeaks[[x]]$start, end = ctPeaks[[x]]$end))
  overlap[[x]] <- which(peaks %in% peaks_ct)  
  rm(x, peaks_ct)
}
overlap <- as.vector(unlist(overlap))
overlap <- unique(overlap)

# filter peak matrix: number of peaks is correct
PeakMatrix_ct <- PeakMatrix[overlap, ]
dim(PeakMatrix_ct) 
# 154622 peaks, FDR <= 0.05, skip permutation: ANX, cogG4, cogG6 (lowest fine-mapping significant SNP count)
# 103369 peaks, FDR <= 0.05 & logFC >= 0.6, skip permutation: ANX, BP, cogG4, cogG6
# 62437 peaks, FDR <= 0.01 & logFC >= 0.6 (true ct-spc), skip permutation: ANX, BP, cogG4, cogG6, SCZ

# clean up
rm(ctPeaks, PeakMatrix, ctMarkerPeaks_7ct, peaks, overlap)
gc()
```

/#### run SCAVENGE

### [3] plotting
#### supp fig - grid all peaks
```{r}
# TRS UMAP
p <- list()
for (x in names(mono_mat_ct)){
  # calculate standardised TRS (z transformation)
  TRS <- mono_mat_ct[[x]]
  TRS$TRS_norm <- (TRS$TRS - mean(TRS$TRS)) / sd(TRS$TRS)

  # prapare data for UMAP
  umap <- ArchR_EHB@embeddings@listData[["UMAP"]]@listData[["df"]]
  names(umap) <- c("umap1","umap2")
  umap$cell <- row.names(umap)
  transfer <- merge(umap, TRS, by.x = "cell", by.y = "names")
  
  # UMAP
  p <- append(p, list(ggplot(transfer, aes(umap1,umap2,colour=TRS_norm)) + 
    geom_point(size = 0.01) + theme_classic() + ggtitle(x) +
    scale_colour_gradientn(colours = c("#badbff","#d1e7ff","#dce9f7","#ebf2fa","#f5f7fa","white",
                                       "#FFFFCC","#FED976","#FEB255","#FC6622","#EE2211","#CC0022","#990000"), 
                           limits = c(-2, 2.5)) +
    theme(axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
          legend.position = "right", plot.margin = unit(c(0.5,0,0.5,0),"cm"))))
  
  # prepare data for bar plot, split into celltype-region groups
  transfer <- data.frame(cell = ArchR_EHB$cellNames, ctRegion = ArchR_EHB$ctRegion)
  transfer <- merge(transfer, TRS, by.x = "cell", by.y = "names")
  transfer$celltype <- sub("_.*","",transfer$ctRegion)
  transfer$region <- sub(".*_","",transfer$ctRegion)
  transfer <- transfer[order(transfer$celltype, transfer$region),]
  transfer$region <- factor(transfer$region, levels = c("FB","CP","MD"))
  transfer$celltype <- factor(transfer$celltype, levels = c("Erythroblast", "Fibroblast", "Glioblast", "RG","n-IPC","Neuroblast","Neuron"))
  
  # test for cell-type-specific enrichment (whether the group average TRS-transform values significantly differs from all cells)
  significance <- data.frame()
  for (y in unique(transfer$ctRegion)){
    sig <- t.test(transfer$TRS_norm[transfer$ctRegion==y], transfer$TRS_norm, alternative = "greater")
    significance <- rbind(significance, c(y, sig$p.value))
  }
  names(significance) <- c("ctRegion","p")
  significance$FDR <- as.numeric(significance$p) * nrow(significance)
  significance$sig <- ""
  significance$sig[significance$FDR < 0.01] <- "*"
  significance$celltype <- sub("_.*","",significance$ctRegion)
  significance$region <- sub(".*_","",significance$ctRegion)
  significance$region <- factor(significance$region, levels = c("FB","CP","MD"))
  significance$position <- max(transfer$TRS_norm) + 0.05
  
  # bar plot 
  p <- append(p, list(
    ggplot(transfer,aes(x=celltype, y=TRS_norm))  +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = celltype), outlier.shape=NA) + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    pretty_plot(fontsize = 15) + facet_wrap(~region) + 
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("FB" = 1, "CP" = 0.75, "MD" = 0.5)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Erythroblast="#f75c63", Fibroblast="#d1a279", Neuron="#3ee2ff", Neuroblast="#00cfff",
                              "n-IPC" = "#40a1ff", RG="#836dff", Glioblast="#c47df0")) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(size = 15), legend.position = "none") +
    geom_text(data = significance, aes(x = celltype, y = position, label = sig), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1))) 

  rm(x, TRS, umap, transfer, y, significance, sig)
}
p[[1]]
```

```{r}
  significance$FDR <- as.numeric(significance$p) * nrow(significance)
  significance$sig <- ""
  significance$sig[significance$FDR < 0.01] <- "*"
  significance$celltype <- sub("_.*","",significance$ctRegion)
  significance$region <- sub(".*_","",significance$ctRegion)
  significance$region <- factor(significance$region, levels = c("FB","CP","MD"))
  significance$position <- max(transfer$TRS_norm) + 0.02
  summary[[x]] <- significance
  
  # bar plot 
  p <- append(p, list(
    ggplot(transfer,aes(x=celltype, y=TRS_norm))  +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = celltype), outlier.shape=NA) + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
    pretty_plot(fontsize = 15) + facet_wrap(~region) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Neuron="#3ee2ff", Neuroblast="#00cfff", "n-IPC" = "#40a1ff", RG="#836dff", Glioblast="#c47df0")) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(size = 15), legend.position = "none",
          strip.background = element_blank(), strip.placement = "outside") +
    geom_text(data = significance, aes(x = celltype, y = position, label = sig), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1))) 

  rm(x, TRS, umap, transfer, y, significance, sig)
}
```

## (3) permutation
Permutation: to establish a statistical significance threshold for identifying significant trait-cell association
-> for *ct-spc-peak* SCAVENGE

### [1] all peaks
```{r temp}
# check that there is no NA due to index mismatch in network propagation
for (x in names(mono_mat_all)){
  print(anyNA(mono_mat_all[[x]]))
  rm(x)
}
```

```{r
# pre-checking: run each code for 2 seconds to make sure they can initiate properly
x <- names(mono_mat_all)[11]
mono_permu <- get_sigcell_simple(mutual_knn_all[[x]], mono_mat_all[[x]]$seed_idx, mono_mat_all[[x]]$np_score, 
                                   permutation_times=1000, true_cell_significance=0.001, rw_gamma=0.05)
```

```{r}
# run permutation ~ 100 min [MacBook M4, 4 in parallel]
mono_mat_permu_all <- pbmclapply(names(mono_mat_all), function(x) {
  mono_permu <- get_sigcell_simple(mutual_knn_all[[x]], mono_mat_all[[x]]$seed_idx, mono_mat_all[[x]]$np_score, 
                                   permutation_times = 1000, true_cell_significance = 0.001, rw_gamma = 0.05)
  result_df <- data.frame(mono_mat_all[[x]], mono_permu)
  return(result_df)
}, mc.cores = 4) # only <= 4 performance cores can use 100% CPU, plus one core for base R - this is a limit for Rstudio rsession and Terminal R
```

#### supp fig - heatmap all peaks
```{r}
# get proportions in each ct-region
sig_summary <- data.frame()
for (x in names(mono_mat_permu_all)){
  sigCells <- mono_mat_permu_all[[x]]$names[mono_mat_permu_all[[x]]$true_cell_top_idx == TRUE]
  for (y in unique(ArchR_EHB$ctRegion)){
    a <- sum(ArchR_EHB$cellNames %in% sigCells & ArchR_EHB$ctRegion==y)
    b <- sum(ArchR_EHB$ctRegion==y)
    sig_summary <- rbind(sig_summary, c(x,y,a,b,a/b))
  }
  rm(x, sigCells, a, b)
}
names(sig_summary) <- c("disease","ctRegion","sigCells","allCells","prop")
sig_summary$prop <- as.numeric(sig_summary$prop)
sig_summary$sigCells <- as.numeric(sig_summary$sigCells)
sig_summary$allCells <- as.numeric(sig_summary$allCells)

# compute odds ratio for each ct-Regoin proportion
sig_summary$odds_ratio <- (sig_summary$sigCells / (sig_summary$allCells - sig_summary$sigCells)) / 
  ((sum(sig_summary$sigCells) - sig_summary$sigCells) / (sum(sig_summary$allCells) - sum(sig_summary$sigCells) - (sig_summary$allCells - sig_summary$sigCells)))

# perform two-sided hypergeometric test
sig_summary$p_value <- phyper(sig_summary$sigCells - 1, sum(sig_summary$sigCells), 
                              sum(sig_summary$allCells) - sum(sig_summary$sigCells), sig_summary$allCells, lower.tail = FALSE)
sig_summary$FDR <- p.adjust(sig_summary$p_value, method = "BH")

# significant cell types
sig_summary$text <- round(sig_summary$odds_ratio, 1)
sig_summary$text[sig_summary$FDR > 0.05] <- ""

# add cell type, region
sig_summary$celltype <- sub("_.*","",sig_summary$ctRegion)
sig_summary$region <- sub(".*_","",sig_summary$ctRegion)
sig_summary$region <- factor(sig_summary$region, levels = c("FB", "CP", "MD"))
sig_summary$celltype <- factor(sig_summary$celltype, levels = 
                                 c("Erythroblast", "Fibroblast", "Glioblast", "RG","n-IPC","Neuroblast","Neuron"))
```

```{r}

ggplot(sig_summary, aes(x=region, y=disease, fill=prop*100)) +
  geom_tile() + theme_bw() + facet_wrap(~celltype, ncol=7) + pretty_plot() +
  geom_text(aes(label = text), color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("white","#FED976","#FEB255","#FC6622","#EE2211","#CC0022","#990000"), name = "% cell") +
  xlab("") + ylab("") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11),

```
